claim: On 2025-03-04 AWS announced that GetSecretValue supports up to 10,000 requests per second and DescribeSecret supports 40,000 requests per second, at no additional cost and applied automatically.
question: When did Secrets Manager raise the DescribeSecret request rate to 40,000 per second?

evidence.quote: GetSecretValue now supports up to 10,000 requests per second and DescribeSecret supports 40,000 requests per second. The increased API limits are available at no additional cost and will automatically be applied to your AWS accounts.

evidence.heading: AWS Secrets Manager increases the API Requests per Second limits

note: d005; the post does not state the old DescribeSecret value; the 2022-11 feed text says GetSecretValue and DescribeSecret were raised to 10,000 then

claim: On 2022-11-11 AWS raised the GetSecretValue and DescribeSecret request rate limits to 10,000 requests per second and the ListSecrets rate to 100 requests per second.
question: When were the Secrets Manager GetSecretValue and DescribeSecret request rates raised to 10,000 per second?

evidence.quote: The request rate limits for GetSecretValue and DescribeSecret have been increased to 10,000 requests per second. The request rate of ListSecrets API operation has been increased to 100 requests per second.

note: d005; evidence is the What's New feed snapshot (the post URL is blocked by robots.txt)
